notes.title: Update 1.20
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25854424/fcf2f54e078cd7073765a5c2fdb6bad449556744.png

For quite some time we have been working on needed fixes to the game. It should work better and faster. We are still working on some optimization tweaks so stay tuned. We are very sorry for being so quiet lately. Despite the large amount of work, we have not forgotten about You and we still care and support our nanobots team. You can find a full changelog below.


FIX


 added caching to the minimap (loading times should go down by a lot)
 cached the minimaps on all levels where the they're needed
 added new graphic settings to greatly improve gameplay on low spec PCs
 fixed broken achievements


Cheers,
Atomic Jelly

notes.title: Release date moved to August 28!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25854424/5a75acc005922e60840938d234d499d530d2d16b.png

Dear Friends! Testing at the final stages of game's development proven that the Project Remedium player's interface requires improvements to increase clarity and intuitiveness. Implementing such changes and testing them requires an extra week... 

August 21 release date has to be moved and we are very sorry to keep you waiting so long. This final rescheduling will guarantee that on August 28 a much more impressive and effective Project Remedium reaches the stores. Thanks for your understanding!

notes.title: New and final release date!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25854424/9aeef9f35c8a95e3e4381b80c28e399713d2a590.png

Sometimes a nano-scaled change can make a difference, so we have decided to move the Project Remedium release date by a week. The new and final release date is August 21.

This will help our small team to tie the loose ends and allow us deliver a better, more polished game to you!
